title: Conditions of the Heart
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Conditions of the Heart | hardened hearts, shallow faith, spiritual fruit, and rooted trust - Luke v8:5-15

God desires fruitful, rooted lives that are nourished by His truth and shaped by His presence. From Luke v8:5-15, we see that the condition of the heart determines what happens when the Word of God is sown. A hardened heart is beaten down by sin, hurt, distraction, and the pull of this world until the seed lies exposed and is quickly stolen away.

A shallow heart may respond with joy for a moment, yet without deep roots it withers when temptation, trouble, or pressure comes. We need more than a quick response; we need a life watered by Scripture, softened by the Holy Spirit, and anchored in Christ. Psalm v1 and Jeremiah v17:7-8 call us to be like trees planted by the waters—steady, green, and still bearing fruit even in dry seasons.
